lines: // A consumed sweep of an active run, also when it returned no new values.
.decl dated_sweep(run: symbol, sweep: symbol, event_time: number)
// The current sweep of a run is its latest dated sweep. A sweep of another run never counts.
.decl current_sweep(run: symbol, sweep: symbol, event_time: number)
current_sweep(run, sweep, time) :- latest_sweep(run, time), dated_sweep(run, sweep, time).
// Only an explicitly complete current sweep can close the round; false and a missing flag cannot.
current_sweep(run, sweep, _), sweep_flag(sweep, complete), complete = TRUE.
// At the inclusive boundary of its budget an unfinished step has expired.
.decl deadline_expired(run: symbol, step: symbol, sweep: symbol, deadline: symbol, start: symbol)
current_sweep(run, sweep, time), until = started + budget, until <= time,
